title: AI-Assisted Development Learning Pathway Generator
description: A structured learning pathway tailored for non-software engineers transitioning into AI-assisted development, focusing on prompt engineering, programming fundamentals, and real-world application.
audience: Non-software engineers with data analytics, SQL, and Excel backgrounds seeking to learn AI-assisted development.
pitch: This product provides a structured, up-to-date learning pathway for non-software engineers to learn AI-assisted development, from prompt engineering to real-world app building and automation.

market_validation.reason: Low-cost original pilot answering a real first-person user problem, with market validation still to be measured. No verified demand or revenue is claimed.

observation.title: Ask HN: How would you learn AI-assisted development from the ground up?

Background's mostly data analytics, SQL and Excel day to day,  [...] y well built, or what's going to break down the road once it gets more complex. Feels like it's time to go back to fundamentals. Michael Jordan still worked on his footwork, that kind of thing.
